wedding.captionEn: ...You serious? You want ME, the lone wolf of the tundras? Heheh. Let's see if you have what it takes to tame me.
wedding.caption: ……你是认真的吗？明明我已经习惯了孤独的雪原……呵呵，如果你真的有驯服我的野心的话，那就让我来见识下你的手段与决心吧，指挥官。

complete.captionEn: I was actually wondering whether you'd remember it or not, but a commission has been completed, Commander.
complete.caption: 我在想指挥官会不会自己记起来委托已经完成了这件事

home.captionEn: I've returned from the mission. Regrouping with original unit.
home.caption: 指挥官，睡一会儿吗？

login.captionEn: Did you have a good rest, Commander? I'm full of energy. Probably.
login.caption: 指挥官休息的还好吗，拉菲现在很有精神，大概

mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail...
mail.caption: 指挥官，您的信……

main_1.captionEn: Commander, don't you think we should plant some flowers?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，我们要不要种点花呢？

main_2.captionEn: Since you're ignoring me, I might as well... *yawns*... get some sleep.
main_2.caption: 指挥官不理拉菲，哈啊……都要睡着噜……

main_3.captionEn: Yes? This is what I look like when I'm happy.
main_3.caption: 嗯？这是拉菲心情好的表现喔

mission.captionEn: Looks like we've still got a few missions to do...
mission.caption: 看来……我们还有任务要做

mission_complete.captionEn: Mhm, we got some rewards.
mission_complete.caption: 恩，我们收到了一批奖励

touch_body.captionEn: Are you tired, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官，累了吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Mmh... Stop shaking me, Commander...
touch_head.caption: 呣……指挥官，不要摇我……

touch_special.captionEn: Are you... a pervert, Commander...?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……莫非是变态？！

wedding.captionEn: I thought I wouldn't mind becoming a demon again if it was for you, Commander… But since you've taken such good care of me, I guess my chance for that is gone… Have I disappointed you, Commander?
wedding.caption: 原本还一直想着，为了指挥官的话，就算再次化身鬼神也无所谓…不过…被指挥官这么关心着…看来是没有机会了呢…指挥官…失望吗？

complete.captionEn: I was actually wondering whether you'd remember it or not, but a commission has been completed, Commander.
complete.caption: 我在想指挥官会不会自己记起来委托已经完成了这件事

home.captionEn: You know the crackles and pops firecrackers make after you light the fuse... *Ughh*... Those are so noisy...
home.caption: 那个红红的，一串一串，烧起来之后砰砰砰砰的……唔，有点吵……

login.captionEn: The Commander's still not back. I might just fall asleep here... Zzzzz...
login.caption: 指挥官还不回来，拉菲要靠着树睡着了……Zzz……

mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail...
mail.caption: 指挥官，您的信……

main_1.captionEn: I'm wearing limited-edition Lunar New Year bunny ears and bunny slippers... do you like them? I like them.
main_1.caption: 春节限定版兔耳和兔兔拖鞋…指挥官喜欢吗？拉菲…很喜欢…

main_2.captionEn: I think Zed is interested in old Lunar New Year folklore...
main_2.caption: Z23，好像对春节的传说很有兴趣的样子……

main_3.captionEn: Sitting on top of this tree makes me feel like I'm going to blossom, too...
main_3.caption: 像这样在树上坐着，拉菲感觉自己也要开花了…

mission.captionEn: Looks like we've still got a few missions to do...
mission.caption: 看来……我们还有任务要做

mission_complete.captionEn: Mhm, we got some rewards.
mission_complete.caption: 恩，我们收到了一批奖励

touch_body.captionEn: I totally don't feel like leaning against your shoulder, Commander. Nope, not at all...
touch_body.caption: 拉菲没有想借指挥官的肩膀靠一会，嗯，并没有……

touch_head.captionEn: Mmh... Stop shaking me, Commander...
touch_head.caption: 呣……指挥官，不要摇我……

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, are you having weird thoughts again...?
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，又在想奇怪的事了吗…

wedding.captionEn: I thought I wouldn't mind becoming a demon again if it was for you, Commander… But since you've taken such good care of me, I guess my chance for that is gone… Have I disappointed you, Commander?
wedding.caption: 原本还一直想着，为了指挥官的话，就算再次化身鬼神也无所谓…不过…被指挥官这么关心着…看来是没有机会了呢…指挥官…失望吗？

complete.captionEn: Our commission team just got home. The pop-up shop... is about to get really busy...
complete.caption: 委托组，回来了。店里等一下会很热闹……吧？

home.captionEn: Commander, your order...? "Anything as long as I'm with Laffey"? Aw, thank you...
home.caption: 指挥官，要点餐吗？……陪伴套餐？当然可以。

login.captionEn: I haven't been looking all over the place for you... Nope, not at all.
login.caption: 拉菲才没有在到处找指挥官呢，嗯，没有。

mail.captionEn: Commander, Laffey put your letters... right here.
mail.caption: 您的信，指挥官……拉菲，放在这里了。

main_1.captionEn: Laffey's job... is to deliver food to the tables... It's not boring because you're here, Commander... Yep.
main_1.caption: 拉菲的任务，把餐点送到桌子上……指挥官在，所以这份工作一点也不无聊……嗯。

main_2.captionEn: If Ingraham made a conveyor belt to deliver the food, would Laffey not have to anymore...?
main_2.caption: 如果英格拉罕能发明菜品传送带的话……拉菲就不用送订单了吧……？

main_3.captionEn: I came to help out... so I'll keep doing my best... I'm not thinking about slacking off with Allen... Nope, not at all...
main_3.caption: 因为是来帮忙的，拉菲想要坚持做完……拉菲没有想和艾伦坐着偷懒，嗯，完全没想过。

main_5.captionEn: Don't worry about Laffey... Even when I'm asleep, I'm plenty alert... Yep...
main_5.caption: 不用担心拉菲……就算睡着了，身体也会自己保持警戒的，嗯……

mission.captionEn: A new mission arrived. Commander, it's time for work... Aww, I have to, too?
mission.caption: 收到了新任务，指挥官，要去工作了。……拉菲也要去吗……？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete... Commander, I'm gonna take a nap... Zzzz...
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，指挥官，拉菲要睡一会儿……Zzzz……

touch_body.captionEn: My bouncy bunny ears look fun to touch...? Umm... I don't understand...
touch_body.caption: 兔兔的耳朵立起来很好摸……？唔……不明白……

touch_head.captionEn: Commander... I'm not eepy, I swear... Okay? Got it?
touch_head.caption: 指挥官，拉菲没有打瞌睡哦……没有，嗯。

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, you pervert... You're gonna make my bunnies fall off...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，变态，衣服上的兔兔要掉下去了……

wedding.captionEn: ...I'm only the Laffey I am now because of how much you care, Commander... Because you're always watching over me... Yep, I promise... Laffey will be together with you forever...
wedding.caption: ……是指挥官的关心，成就了现在的拉菲。只要是拉菲，指挥官就会一直看着……所以、嗯…拉菲也和指挥官约定，拉菲会一直和指挥官在一起。

complete.captionEn: (Grooooowl...) Oh, is the commission team back already?
complete.caption: 是委托组回来了吗？

home.captionEn: Looks like Regina's having a good time with its friends. Why don't you take a break as well? Surely you're not trying to test the limits of your weary body.
home.caption: 雷吉纳好像在和朋友玩耍。你也差不多该休息下了吧？你该不会是想试试看，以你这疲惫的身体能撑多久吧？

login.captionEn: Hehe, even someone like you is powerless before my allure. Those ruled by their emotions are easy to control, just like riggings.
login.caption: 呵呵，即使是你这样的人也难以抵挡我的魅力。被自己的情感支配的存在，就像舰装一样易于控制呢。

mail.captionEn: We've got a new message. What did Eisen break this time, Regina? ...Oh, it's something else?
mail.caption: 有新消息…雷吉纳，是小铁又闯了什么祸吗？不是么…

main_1.captionEn: Hm? What are you trying to... Hyeep?! G-get your hands off my tail this instant! Didn't you hear me?!
main_1.caption: ？你这是…吓！？快，快把你的手从我的尾巴上移开！没听到吗？！

main_2.captionEn: (Rooooar...) Looks like Regina's gone pretty far out to sea. Hope it doesn't run into any trouble.
main_2.caption: 雷吉纳好像跑到海深处去了，希望它不要遇到什么危险。

main_3.captionEn: Since you're here at the beach, surely you have a thing or two you'd like to do? Come on, let yourself loose already.
main_3.caption: 既然来到了海边，那应该有一两件特别想做的事吧？来，随你心意行动就好。

mission.captionEn: A job? What job could be more important than enjoying your time off at the beach?
mission.caption: 任务啊。现在除了享受大海之外，什么任务都不存在吧？

mission_complete.captionEn: One can never get enough rewards. Same is always true regardless of what form they come in.
mission_complete.caption: 报酬永远不嫌多。无论哪种形式的报酬都是这个道理呢。

touch_body.captionEn: (That's right! Bare your weaknesses to me as I pretend to be subservient...!)
touch_body.caption: （对了…！我就顺势装个乖好了，在我面前暴露你的弱点吧…！）

touch_head.captionEn: Wha?!
touch_head.caption: 什么？！

touch_special.captionEn: Huh?! Wh-why do you know where my weak spot is...?!
touch_special.caption: …！？为，为什么对我的弱点…！

wedding.captionEn: Kh! Why am I... unable to refuse a lower being such as you...? Damn it, how did you become... stronger, and more superior? ..A ring? Do you mean to tie me down?!
wedding.caption: 可恶！我居然会被你这样的低等存在…无法拒绝…无法拒绝更强，更高等的指挥官——你到底是用了什么手段把我……？难道你想束缚我吗…！？

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission has finished.
complete.caption: ……指挥官，有委托完成了

home.captionEn: Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.
home.caption: 指挥官在战场上和我有点像，稍微……有点帅

login.captionEn: Commander, have you eaten yet? Here's some snacks.
login.caption: 指挥官，吃了吗？我这里还有点心

mail.captionEn: There's... new mail...
mail.caption: 有新的……邮件……

main_1.captionEn: Ayanami's ears... are they cute? I don't understand... As long as you're happy, Commander!
main_1.caption: 绫波的耳朵……比较可爱吗？不太懂……指挥官开心就好

main_2.captionEn: I've been having nightmares of all the girls getting lost... I'm certain that it's my fault, too...
main_2.caption: 最近时常会做和大家走散的噩梦，一定是我做的还不够好……

main_3.captionEn: Commander? No, nothing. I just wanted to see if you were here or not.
main_3.caption: 指挥官？…不，没事。我只是确认一下你是不是还在

mission.captionEn: Commander, we've been notified of new missions.
mission.caption: 指挥官的新任务下达了

mission_complete.captionEn: The rewards for the previous mission are here.
mission_complete.caption: 之前完成的任务，奖励送来了……

touch_body.captionEn: Uuu... it tickles...a bit.
touch_body.caption: 唔——有点痒……

touch_head.captionEn: I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...
touch_head.caption: 虽然不太明白这样有什么意义……但是有点高兴（蹭蹭）

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... please... don't touch there so much... It's making me feel weird...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，请不要……乱碰，感觉……有点奇怪

wedding.captionEn: Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...
wedding.caption: 放心吧，这次我无论如何都会活下来，然后回到指挥官面前……因为……我想见指挥官……

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission has finished.
complete.caption: ……指挥官，有委托完成了

home.captionEn: Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.
home.caption: 指挥官在战场上和我有点像，稍微……有点帅

login.captionEn: "It is unbefitting to keep a lady waiting." —That was just a joke. Commander, welcome back.
login.caption: “让淑女久等不是绅士所为”——开玩笑的。指挥官，欢迎回来的说。

mail.captionEn: There's... new mail...
mail.caption: 有新的……邮件……

main_1.captionEn: Z23 seems to be fitting in just fine, but... I'm still a bit nervous. Commander, don't leave me alone.
main_1.caption: Z23…感觉对这种场合很习惯了的说。绫波…有点紧张…指挥官，不要离开绫波身边。

main_2.captionEn: To get rid of my nerves... maybe I should try releasing the †Force† like that one person taught me... Is that a bad idea?
main_2.caption: 要缓解紧张的话，只能发动小伙伴传授的力量<Force>……不行吗？

main_3.captionEn: Listening to the piano makes me a bit sleepy... Commander, you're not getting sleepy?
main_3.caption: 听着弹钢琴的声音，总觉得有点困……指挥官不困吗？

mission.captionEn: Commander, we've been notified of new missions.
mission.caption: 指挥官的新任务下达了

mission_complete.captionEn: The rewards for the previous mission are here.
mission_complete.caption: 之前完成的任务，奖励送来了……

touch_body.captionEn: ...Ah! Ayanami... is awake now...
touch_body.caption: ……啊。绫波，不困的……

touch_head.captionEn: I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...
touch_head.caption: 虽然不太明白这样有什么意义……但是有点高兴（蹭蹭）

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... you're acting a bit weird...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官…感觉有点奇怪？

wedding.captionEn: Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...
wedding.caption: 放心吧，这次我无论如何都会活下来，然后回到指挥官面前……因为……我想见指挥官……

complete.captionEn: The commission came back. You want to go out and see them?
complete.caption: 委托组回来了哦，指挥官，一起去迎接她们吧~

home.captionEn: When Reno Bunnino's beloved commander comes home to roost, that's her time to shine.
home.caption: 在最尊敬的指挥官休息的时候，就是bunny reno开始行动的时候……

login.captionEn: What can I get you, Commander?
login.caption: 指挥官，今天想喝点什么呢？

mail.captionEn: Mail for you, Commander. Is it a fan letter?
mail.caption: 有你的邮件哦，指挥官，会不会是粉丝信什么的呀？

main_1.captionEn: So I was telling everyone about Reno Bunnino, and for whatever reason, North Carolina was super keen to hear it... Not like that's a bad thing. More friends is always good!
main_1.caption: 不知道为什么，把bunny reno的设定告诉大家后，北卡罗来纳好像很感兴趣，甚至想要加入呢……不过同伴增加是好事呢！

main_2.captionEn: Hungry, Commander? Vestal taught me a handful of recipes. I could cook something up for you.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你饿了吗？嘻嘻，我有向女灶神请教过厨艺哦，我来为你做点什么吧~

main_3.captionEn: Y'know, I think this Reno Bunnino's thing really gonna take off. I'm counting on you to facilitate that, Commander.
main_3.caption: 感觉……说不定bunny reno意外地能成为潮流呢！指挥官也请多多捧场哦~

mission.captionEn: We got a lot to do... But I'm sure you can knock it out easy peasy, Commander!
mission.caption: 这次下达的任务也有不少呢……不过我相信对指挥官来说都是小菜一碟~

mission_complete.captionEn: That's my Commander! You always get the best rewards!
mission_complete.caption: 不愧是指挥官，这次的任务报酬也很丰盛呢！

touch_body.captionEn: This gauntlet I'm always wearing? Oh, uh, I've not made my Reno Bunnino tool belt just yet, so I'm making do with this for now.
touch_body.caption: 啊，我的手甲吗？这个啊，因为bunny reno专属的武器还没有做好，所以就暂时拿来代替了~

touch_special.captionEn: If you're doing what I think you are... Yeah, sorry, there aren't many clothes my size.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……要找到适合我尺寸的衣服可不太容易！

wedding.captionEn: So like, from now on I'm more than just your sidekick. I gotta learn how to be a partner to you too, for the rest of your life... I don't really know how to do that ♪ so you'll just have to speak up and tell me what to do~
wedding.caption: 那么，从今天起，我就是指挥官的助手兼人生伴侣了~嗯嗯，虽然作为助手要做的事我已经很熟练了，不过作为人生伴侣的话……完全不知道♪要是有想让我做的事记得告诉我哦，指挥官~

complete.captionEn: The commission came back. You want to go out and see them?
complete.caption: 委托组回来了哦，指挥官，一起去迎接她们吧~

home.captionEn: When Reno Bunnino's beloved commander comes home to roost, that's her time to shine.
home.caption: 在最尊敬的指挥官休息的时候，就是bunny reno开始行动的时候……

login.captionEn: What can I get you, Commander?
login.caption: 指挥官，今天想喝点什么呢？

mail.captionEn: Mail for you, Commander. Is it a fan letter?
mail.caption: 有你的邮件哦，指挥官，会不会是粉丝信什么的呀？

main_1.captionEn: So I was telling everyone about Reno Bunnino, and for whatever reason, North Carolina was super keen to hear it... Not like that's a bad thing. More friends is always good!
main_1.caption: 不知道为什么，把bunny reno的设定告诉大家后，北卡罗来纳好像很感兴趣，甚至想要加入呢……不过同伴增加是好事呢！

main_2.captionEn: Hungry, Commander? Vestal taught me a handful of recipes. I could cook something up for you.
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你饿了吗？嘻嘻，我有向女灶神请教过厨艺哦，我来为你做点什么吧~

main_3.captionEn: Y'know, I think this Reno Bunnino's thing really gonna take off. I'm counting on you to facilitate that, Commander.
main_3.caption: 感觉……说不定bunny reno意外地能成为潮流呢！指挥官也请多多捧场哦~

mission.captionEn: We got a lot to do... But I'm sure you can knock it out easy peasy, Commander!
mission.caption: 这次下达的任务也有不少呢……不过我相信对指挥官来说都是小菜一碟~

mission_complete.captionEn: That's my Commander! You always get the best rewards!
mission_complete.caption: 不愧是指挥官，这次的任务报酬也很丰盛呢！

touch_body.captionEn: This gauntlet I'm always wearing? Oh, uh, I've not made my Reno Bunnino tool belt just yet, so I'm making do with this for now.
touch_body.caption: 啊，我的手甲吗？这个啊，因为bunny reno专属的武器还没有做好，所以就暂时拿来代替了~

touch_special.captionEn: If you're doing what I think you are... Yeah, sorry, there aren't many clothes my size.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……要找到适合我尺寸的衣服可不太容易！

wedding.captionEn: So like, from now on I'm more than just your sidekick. I gotta learn how to be a partner to you too, for the rest of your life... I don't really know how to do that ♪ so you'll just have to speak up and tell me what to do~
wedding.caption: 那么，从今天起，我就是指挥官的助手兼人生伴侣了~嗯嗯，虽然作为助手要做的事我已经很熟练了，不过作为人生伴侣的话……完全不知道♪要是有想让我做的事记得告诉我哦，指挥官~

complete.captionEn: We have a really good view from up here. I can even see a commission group starting to return out there.
complete.caption: 这里的视野很好，指挥官，你看，恰好能看到海平线上返回的委托组

home.captionEn: I don't wish for my absence to become a burden on you, Commander. If there's anything I can help with, please let me know.
home.caption: 我并不希望我的休息是以你的额外劳动换来的，指挥官，有任何需要帮忙的地方请尽管提出来

login.captionEn: Scenery that calms the heart... Commander, you've got good taste.
login.caption: 一个风景优美的地方，指挥官，你很会挑选

mail.captionEn: Letters are blessings from other people.
mail.caption: 信件，是来自他人的祝福。

main_1.captionEn: Commander, I'll be heading to the beach for a bit. ... Hehe. Indeed, this is a bit different from how I am usually. Would you like to come along with me?
main_1.caption: 我去海里稍微游一会儿。…？呵呵，确实和我平常的印象不太一致呢。指挥官，你要一起来吗？

main_2.captionEn: Frozen treats are most effective against hot and humid weather like this... Shall we ask Dunkerque to prepare some more next time?
main_2.caption: 炎热的盛夏与冰凉的甜食…不得不说是绝配呢，下次请敦刻尔克再多做一些好了…

main_3.captionEn: Jean Bart... Perhaps it's better to spend some more time with her... Sigh...
main_3.caption: 我偶尔也会思考，与让·巴尔共同度过一段时间对于我们的关系或许是有必要的呢…哈啊…

mission.captionEn: Missions may be called a kind of trial. If you take them on with the proper attitude, there is no need to worry.
mission.caption: 任务，也是一种试炼。怀着正确的心态完成即可。

mission_complete.captionEn: The reward for those who work hard is Heaven's grace. Let us accept it gratefully.
mission_complete.caption: 奖励，是上天给与勤劳者的馈赠。心怀感激地接受便是。

touch_body.captionEn: My... Where are you taking me, Commander?
touch_body.caption: 你要带我去哪里，指挥官？

touch_head.captionEn: May Heaven confer upon you its blessings.
touch_head.caption: 愿你也能得到上天的祝福

touch_special.captionEn: If you know what's good for you, I wouldn't assume that a girl is defenseless just because she's in a swimsuit.
touch_special.caption: 穿着泳装就变得毫无防备了——还是不要有这么天真的想法比较好哦，指挥官

wedding.captionEn: As the one who guides Iris Libre, I cannot make an oath solely to you. However, I vow to protect and support you for as long as I live. This, I vow, on the holy name of Iris...
wedding.caption: 作为自由鸢尾的领导者，我无法向你许下诺言。但作为战舰黎塞留，我愿立誓成为永远守护你、支援你的存在。以神圣的鸢尾之名——

complete.captionEn: It seems the commissions team made it back safely. This counts as good fortune, doesn't it?
complete.caption: 委托组平安回来了。所谓的“开门大吉”就是这样吧。

home.captionEn: Please calm down and ponder what we should do. I'll be waiting right over here.
home.caption: 不要着急，先安排出击的各位休息吧，我会在这里等你的。

login.captionEn: It looks like you went out to take a glimpse of the morning sun. I look forward to being in your company today, Commander.
login.caption: 又迎来了一轮崭新的朝阳，今天也请多指教了，指挥官。

mail.captionEn: So this is what the Sakura Empire's New Year's greeting cards look like... How interesting. Hehehe.
mail.caption: 重樱的贺年卡是这种感觉的吗…挺有意思的，呵呵…

main_1.captionEn: I believe that any obstacle can be overcome with fervent faith and untiring efforts.
main_1.caption: 「FVRENTIBVS EMINET AVSTRIS」…我坚信，只要有坚定的信仰和不懈的努力，无论任何苦难都无法将我们打倒——

main_2.captionEn: Those round little creatures... If I recall correctly, Algérie told me they're called "Meowfficers."
main_2.caption: 港区里那些孩子们…是叫「指挥喵」吗…？呵呵，真是惹人怜爱的小家伙呢。

main_3.captionEn: What these fortunes tell may be your fate. Even so, is it not mankind's strength to overcome fate?
main_3.caption: “抽签”展示的或许正是命运，即便如此，人类的顽强，还是能够打破既定宿命的吧。

mission.captionEn: Missions may be called a kind of trial. If you take them on with the proper attitude, there is no need to worry.
mission.caption: 任务，也是一种试炼。怀着正确的心态完成即可。

mission_complete.captionEn: The reward for those who work hard is Heaven's grace. Let us accept it gratefully.
mission_complete.caption: 奖励，是上天给与勤劳者的馈赠。心怀感激地接受便是。

touch_body.captionEn: You'd like to sit by my side? Up we go... Good kitty... Alright, here you go, Commander.
touch_body.caption: 指挥官也要坐过来吗？请稍等…乖孩子…好了，请坐。

touch_head.captionEn: May Heaven confer upon you its blessings.
touch_head.caption: 愿你也能得到上天的祝福

touch_special.captionEn: Is this a greeting... for the New Year?
touch_special.caption: 这是…新年的打招呼方式吗？

wedding.captionEn: As the one who guides Iris Libre, I cannot make an oath solely to you. However, I vow to protect and support you for as long as I live. This, I vow, on the holy name of Iris...
wedding.caption: 作为自由鸢尾的领导者，我无法向你许下诺言。但作为战舰黎塞留，我愿立誓成为永远守护你、支援你的存在。以神圣的鸢尾之名——

complete.captionEn: The commissions have been completed. I shall go ahead and greet them first. ...I hope their bounty is plentiful.
complete.caption: 委托完成了。我先去迎接她们了，但愿这次是个大丰收。

home.captionEn: You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.
home.caption: 如果扶桑和山城忙不过来的话，辟邪的仪式交给我也可以哦？这方面还是有点心得的呢

login.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!
login.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。破魔矢的准备就交给我吧！

mail.captionEn: A letter has arrived. I'm curious about its contents... Are you not?
mail.caption: 信件，里面会是什么样内容……很在意呢

main_1.captionEn: The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?
main_1.caption: 隼鹰那样子…嗯，指挥官，感到困扰的时候可以找我聊聊没关系哦？

main_2.captionEn: Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.
main_2.caption: 时雨以前帮过我不少忙呢，所以现在我还会偶尔做点东西给她吃。别看她那样，其实是个好孩子呢

main_3.captionEn: Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.
main_3.caption: 指挥官要写写绘马吗？就算没能实现愿望，能写下当下的所思所想也是不错的呢

mission.captionEn: A new mission... If it's a directive from the top brass, let's take care of it right away.
mission.caption: 新的任务么……既然是上面的指令，还是尽快完成吧。

mission_complete.captionEn: We were able to handle the mission flawlessly thanks to your hard work, Commander.
mission_complete.caption: 有了指挥官的努力，任务才能完成得如此顺利。

touch_body.captionEn: Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...
touch_body.caption: 呼呼…指挥官也来喝点甜酒吧？不会醉的

touch_special.captionEn: ...W-What are you planning...?
touch_special.caption: ……你、你想做什么…？

wedding.captionEn: I, Ryuuhou, vow to be at your side, through thick and thin... W-Well then, from now on, I will not hide any part of myself from you, so prepare yourself... okay?
wedding.caption: 龙凤，今后也会陪伴在你的身边，与你共同进退。……今、今后我会用真实的自己面对指挥官你的，请做好觉悟…………吧？

complete.captionEn: The commissions have been completed. I shall go ahead and greet them first. ...I hope their bounty is plentiful.
complete.caption: 委托完成了。我先去迎接她们了，但愿这次是个大丰收。

home.captionEn: You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.
home.caption: 如果扶桑和山城忙不过来的话，辟邪的仪式交给我也可以哦？这方面还是有点心得的呢

login.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!
login.caption: 指挥官，辛苦了。破魔矢的准备就交给我吧！

mail.captionEn: A letter has arrived. I'm curious about its contents... Are you not?
mail.caption: 信件，里面会是什么样内容……很在意呢

main_1.captionEn: The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?
main_1.caption: 隼鹰那样子…嗯，指挥官，感到困扰的时候可以找我聊聊没关系哦？

main_2.captionEn: Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.
main_2.caption: 时雨以前帮过我不少忙呢，所以现在我还会偶尔做点东西给她吃。别看她那样，其实是个好孩子呢

main_3.captionEn: Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.
main_3.caption: 指挥官要写写绘马吗？就算没能实现愿望，能写下当下的所思所想也是不错的呢

mission.captionEn: A new mission... If it's a directive from the top brass, let's take care of it right away.
mission.caption: 新的任务么……既然是上面的指令，还是尽快完成吧。

mission_complete.captionEn: We were able to handle the mission flawlessly thanks to your hard work, Commander.
mission_complete.caption: 有了指挥官的努力，任务才能完成得如此顺利。

touch_body.captionEn: Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...
touch_body.caption: 呼呼…指挥官也来喝点甜酒吧？不会醉的

touch_special.captionEn: ...W-What are you planning...?
touch_special.caption: ……你、你想做什么…？

wedding.captionEn: I, Ryuuhou, vow to be at your side, through thick and thin... W-Well then, from now on, I will not hide any part of myself from you, so prepare yourself... okay?
wedding.caption: 龙凤，今后也会陪伴在你的身边，与你共同进退。……今、今后我会用真实的自己面对指挥官你的，请做好觉悟…………吧？

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back, huh... I'll go prep a banquet. Everyone's gonna be able to eat to their heart's content.
complete.caption: 委托组……回来了啊……我准备了接风宴……嗯，管饱。

home.captionEn: Welcome back! Want some tanghulu? Ning Hai and Ping Hai brought some over. They're really tasty~
home.caption: 回来啦……要吃冰糖葫芦吗？是宁海和平海给我的，很好吃呢！

login.captionEn: Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? Lucky money present for me? Thank you very much... That makes me very happy~♪
login.caption: 指挥官，新年好~……这是给我的红包？好开心……谢谢！

mail.captionEn: So many messages... Are they all cards wishing you a happy new year?
mail.caption: 好多新邮件……是寄给指挥官的新年贺卡吗？

main_1.captionEn: What in the world is this baozi?! The texture of the dough, the exquisite flavor of the filling! I hate to admit this, but it's better than what I can make! I, I need to research this later...!
main_1.caption: 这包子！这面粉的口感，这内馅的调味！虽然有点不甘心，但是这包子确实比我做的好吃！之后一定要好好钻研一下！

main_2.captionEn: Commander, I hope everything goes well this coming year~ Ehehe. Please let me handle all of your daily meals as well. I'll make sure everything is delicious and healthy~♪
main_2.caption: 祝指挥官在新的一年，万事如意！嘿嘿……新的一年里，就让我来包揽指挥官的每日三餐吧！保证美味又健康~

main_3.captionEn: Heehee~ I snuck into the kitchen earlier to make those spring rolls I put on your desk. ..Too spicy? Spicy is good! You're supposed to welcome the new year with a bang! Ugh, my head is spinning... Who swapped out all the cooking wine in the kitchen with Hua Tiao wine?
main_3.caption: 嘿嘿~桌上的春卷是龙武溜进厨房做的……好辣？辣就对了！新年……当然要红红火火……！头好晕，是谁把厨房的料酒换成了花雕……

mission.captionEn: New missions, huh? Let's work together to get things taken care of. The food's gonna go cold if we take too long.
mission.caption: 有新任务啊……让我们一起快速解决掉吧？再拖拉下去，饭菜都要冷掉了。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Let's count up the rewards, then head back to enjoy a nice New Year feast!
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了！一起去清点报酬，然后一起回来吃新年大餐吧~！

touch_body.captionEn: Hmm? Commander, want some baozi?
touch_body.caption: 嗯……？指挥官，要来个包子吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Nngh... If my hair gets all messy, you'll be responsible for combing it back...
touch_head.caption: 唔……发型要是乱了的话，你要负责重新帮我梳好哦……

touch_special.captionEn: Commander... H-Hu Pen can still see us...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官……虎、虎贲还在呢……

wedding.captionEn: Th-this is... Really?! G-give me a moment to get my thoughts straight... I mean, I can't do anything other than cook... *huff* *huff*... Alright, Commander... If you don't mind, I'll be in charge of all your meals from now on, and make sure everything is healthy and delicious!
wedding.caption: 这、这是……？！让、让我消化一下……做菜之外的事……我一直都不太……呼……如、如果指挥官觉得可以的话……我、我会让你今后人生中的每一餐都美味又健康的！

complete.captionEn: I can see the commission team all the way from up here. Well? Are you heading out to greet them?
complete.caption: 从这里可以看到委托组的伙伴们哦？怎么办？要去迎接她们吗？

home.captionEn: Welcome back! Let's give you a nice, waaarm hug♪
home.caption: 欢迎回来~给你治愈的拥抱♪

login.captionEn: Good timing, actually – the party was starting to bore me. Thanks for pulling me out, Commander~
login.caption: 其实我也刚开始觉得派对有些乏味了呢。谢谢你，指挥官♪

mail.captionEn: It's not any bad news, is it?
mail.caption: 邮件里没有不好的消息吧？

main_1.captionEn: While I like vistas as much as the next person, I'm awfully fed up with the port's scenery at this point. Battlefields differ in that regard... Ahh... I'll never tire of seeing them.
main_1.caption: 欣赏风景是不错，不过总是看着港区的景色，难免有些腻了呢~果然还是战场的风景好呀…啊啊…无论何时看都不会腻呢…

main_2.captionEn: Heehee~ Don't you worry, I'm not going anywhere. Why would I, when it's you who brought me here?
main_2.caption: 呵呵，不用担心，我哪里都不会去的~毕竟带我来这的可是指挥官呢，对吧？

main_3.captionEn: Since we have access to a piano, could you help me work on my singing? I'm starting to feel restless from sitting around for too long... Heehee~
main_3.caption: 难得有钢琴在这里，能陪我练习唱歌吗？什么都不做的话，总觉得有些静不下心呢，呵呵~

mission.captionEn: What might this next mission be? I'm getting a little excited.
mission.caption: 这次会是什么样的任务呢？稍微有点期待起来了

mission_complete.captionEn: Let's give our all on the next mission, too.
mission_complete.caption: 下一个任务，也一同加油吧

touch_body.captionEn: Oh, you're back already? Then please, come here and let your heart be soothed♪
touch_body.caption: 想回去了吗？那么，请去治愈疲累的心吧♪

touch_special.captionEn: Go on – we're all alone here~♥
touch_special.caption: 没有别人在哦～♥

wedding.captionEn: Thank you so much. But listen, I finally understand now. What filled the void in my heart wasn't slaughter on the battlefield or love, it was the hatred known as "envy"... Commander, I love you just as much as I deeply, deeply, DEEPLY hate those other girls... THEY WILL PAY!
wedding.caption: 谢谢你哦，不过呢，最终填补了我内心空虚的既不是杀戮的愉悦也不是爱情的甜蜜，而是嫉妒的愤恨呢！指挥官，现在我对他人的妒恨与对你的爱一样多喔……真是——不可原谅呢！

complete.captionEn: New commission rewards have just arrived.
complete.caption: 新的委托物资，现在送到了。

home.captionEn: I told you to stay here, didn't I? To make up for leaving, you shall spend twice as long rehearsing a pas de deux with me.
home.caption: 我说过的吧？哪里也不要去。作为擅自离开的代价，双人舞的部分你可要付出双倍的时间来配合我。

login.captionEn: Our march fades into the blackness on nights with dim moonlight. That is likely the reason I why couldn't detect your presence here.
login.caption: 月光稀薄的夜晚，能有效地掩盖行军的痕迹。这大概就是我没能第一时间发现你的原因吧。

mail.captionEn: You have a new letter. I believe it's a ballet invitation. Shall we attend, or are you too busy? I shall dispose of it if so.
mail.caption: 新的信件，看起来是演出的邀请函。要答应么？不答应的话，我替你撕了吧。

main_1.captionEn: You wish to see me perform on the stage? I'd be happy to if it would spread Romulus' splendor... However, I ask that you be patient until I've perfected my dance.
main_1.caption: 希望我也能在众人面前表演？若是能展示罗穆路斯之威光，那自然是好事。不过，这得等到我认为能做到“完美”之后。

main_2.captionEn: While the cursed princess-turned-swan can only reassume her human form at midnight, I can dance whenever I please.
main_2.caption: 身受诅咒的公主唯有午夜时分，才能片刻地摆脱天鹅之躯。至于我，自然是想何时起舞，便何时起舞。

main_3.captionEn: Garibaldi, despite the nonchalance she ordinarily displays, plays the black swan quite well. I sincerely acknowledge her skill.
main_3.caption: 平时散漫的加里波第，扮演起黑天鹅时倒是有模有样的。她作为舞者的实力，我认同了。

mission.captionEn: New missions? I'm afraid now is not the right time for those.
mission.caption: 任务？现在不是被这种东西打扰的时候。

mission_complete.captionEn: A mission has been completed. Strange, as I could've sworn you've been here from the start... Are you able to clone yourself? Heehee.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了。但你一直在这里。莫非你会分身的邪术？

touch_body.captionEn: This is what a pas de deux is like? How novel.
touch_body.caption: 原来双人的舞步是这样的么？有趣。

touch_head.captionEn: Do you wish to obtain my blessings, Commander?
touch_head.caption: 你想要获得罗马的祝福么，指挥官？

touch_special.captionEn: You needn't be shy to admit whether or not Roma has conquered your heart, Commander. I already know the answer.
touch_special.caption: 指挥官也拜倒在罗马的魅力下了么？不用害羞，我明白的。

wedding.captionEn: You and I are now as one, bound together unto eternity. In other words, defiance against you is defiance against me... Be a little more considerate of others, you say? Very well. If that's what you wish... then I shall try.
wedding.caption: 从今往后，你我便立场一致，永不分离。任何对于你的忤逆，都是对于罗马的忤逆。嗯…？你希望我也能多为他人着想？既然这是你的要求的话。为他人着想……我试试看吧。

complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. I wonder what tributes they've brought me.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了，让我看看有什么好的贡品。

home.captionEn: They've changed my port so drastically I don't know what's what anymore... I should've stayed home since the Commander's away... Whuah?! C-Commander?!
home.caption: 明明是自己的港区却搞不懂发生了什么……指挥官也不在，早知道就不来了……呀？！指，指挥官？！

login.captionEn: So for the Spring Festival, a carp is needed as decoration, which then turns into a dragon... Doesn't make any sense to me. Besides, how in the world is a fish supposed to turn into... Whuah?! What the heck was that?!
login.caption: “春节”要用鲤鱼装饰，然后那个鲤鱼变成龙……真是搞不懂。说起来为什么鲤鱼会变成龙——哇？！怎，怎么回事？！

mail.captionEn: A letter... Nothing I'd care about, it seems.
mail.caption: 邮件啊……看来跟我无关。

main_1.captionEn: Ägir mentioned a lion that dances in the air – I want to check it out... If I SAY it flies, then it FLIES, okay?! And you're going with me, obviously!
main_1.caption: 去看下埃吉尔说的，在天上飞的狮子好了……本小姐说在天上飞就是在天上飞！当然，你也要和我一起来！

main_2.captionEn: A red envelope? Are you that strapped for cash even though you run this place? ...Hm? You're giving it to me? I don't want it! Blep!
main_2.caption: 压岁钱？平时运营着港区结果自己却囊中羞涩吗？……嗯？是要给我的？我才不要呢！

main_3.captionEn: Here's what happens to idiots who don't pay attention to me! Hahaha! That's right, run in fear from my firecrackers!
main_3.caption: 总是不理我的笨蛋，看招！哈哈，被爆竹吓得抱头鼠窜吧！

mission.captionEn: Missions, eh... Do them yourself. I'm above all that busywork.
mission.caption: 任务啊……随你便了，跟我没关系。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards! I've claimed them in my na– What the hell! This is just a list!
mission_complete.caption: 任务的报酬由我收下了♪。什么嘛，只是清单而已啊

touch_body.captionEn: Where did that cretin bumble off to... Hyeep?! D-don't just sneak up on me out of the blue!
touch_body.caption: 指挥官那家伙，跑到哪里去了……呜哇！我我我刚才才没有叫指挥官你呢！不许随便搭茬！

touch_head.captionEn: Blep!
touch_head.caption: （吐舌头）呸——><

touch_special.captionEn: D-don't you dare blame it on my dress!
touch_special.caption: 你、你对我这身有什么意见吗！

wedding.captionEn: Marriage? What are you talking about? This is an act of insolence on your part, one-sidedly hoping I'll exchange vows with you. Obviously, it's my choice whether to accept or refuse... If you want my hand so badly, cry and plead for it one more time! And don't try to run away!
wedding.caption: 誓约？你在说什么？这是你没规没矩，单方面“希望和我立下誓约”的行为，自然无论同意还是拒绝都随我……想让我怎么做的话，就再大喊1遍吧！可不准逃哦！

complete.captionEn: Commander, my sisters in arms have returned from their commission.
complete.caption: 指挥官，我看到委托的同僚们返回了

home.captionEn: I would much rather wield my spear upon the seas of battle than sit up here like a statue, Commander.
home.caption: 比起像一尊雕塑一样坐在这里，我更想与你一起踏上战场，指挥官

login.captionEn: Commander, making me sit up here waiting for you by myself is a tribulation in its own right.
login.caption: 指挥官，让我一个人坐在这里是一种煎熬

mail.captionEn: Commander, does it not matter if these letters remain unopened?
mail.caption: 指挥官，信件不拆封没有关系吗

main_1.captionEn: So I've managed to capture your gaze? Your eyes are... Nevermind, it doesn't bother me.
main_1.caption: 指挥官，现在的我有这么惹人注目吗？我能感受到你的视线——不，我对此并不反感

main_2.captionEn: My arbitration is needed? ...Very well, please excuse me for a moment. I will make sure to hear them out.
main_2.caption: 坐在这里仲裁同僚之间的纠纷？那就…失礼了，让我先好好听听她们所言所感吧。

main_3.captionEn: As the one guiding this fleet forward... Commander, you are the one best suited to this throne.
main_3.caption: 指挥官，你是这里的统帅，我想这王座应当由你来坐才最合适

mission.captionEn: Commander, it may not be the will of God, but you do have new missions issued from headquarters.
mission.caption: 指挥官，虽然不是神的旨意，不过军部的任务下达了

mission_complete.captionEn: While rewards may certainly be nice... I have no interest in them.
mission_complete.caption: 奖励吗……虽然都是些不错的东西，不过我没有兴趣

touch_body.captionEn: My weapon is always within reach. Should you will it, I am ready to sortie at any time.
touch_body.caption: 武器就在我的身边，如果要上战场，我随时都可以

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, your self-respect...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，请自重……

wedding.captionEn: This I do swear. Your joy is my will, your victory is my glory, and the place that I can call home, is by your side... Blessed be the Lord who has brought me together with you - my commander, my love, and... my light.
wedding.caption: 你的身边将是我的归所，你的胜利将是我的荣光，你的喜悦将是我唯一的动力。感谢神将我送到了你的面前，我的先知，我的爱人，我的……光

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. We don't have to go out and meet them, do we?
complete.caption: 哦豁，负责委托的同伴们已经回来了。不去迎接她们没关系么？

home.captionEn: You're under my complete control, and will always come back to me... Heehee, I call this plot device "the curse of Dracula's Castle."
home.caption: 兜兜转转了一阵子，最终还是回到我身边了呢。这个就是“来自吸血鬼古堡的诅咒”的设定~

login.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. Now where's my crimson elixir? As in, my daily glass of wine~
login.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。今天的“鲜血”准备好了吗？当然指的是葡萄酒哦~

mail.captionEn: Here's your mail. No need to thank me, I just picked it up on the way.
mail.caption: 给，邮件。顺手拿的不用谢我~

main_1.captionEn: Garlic? Crosses? Those don't work on me... Those are meant to repel a vampire? Well then, I'm throwing those weaknesses right out the window.
main_1.caption: 大蒜？十字架？那种东西对我可没有用哦。吸血鬼都是这种设定？那我只要把这个设定吃掉就好了~

main_2.captionEn: Seydlitz, the key to acting is to fully immerse yourself in your role. You don't have to think about it too hard.
main_2.caption: 塞德利茨，所谓“扮演”只要把自己想象成那个角色就好了，不用顾忌那么多的~

main_3.captionEn: Hrmph. I'm trying my absolute best here, and you're not even looking, Commander... I'll just have to MAKE you pay attention!
main_3.caption: 欸，人家在这里专心扮演，你怎么一副心不在焉的样子…不行，我要咬你两口让你清醒清醒！

mission.captionEn: A mission? Miss me with that. You'll be fine on your own anyway.
mission.caption: 任务？听起来就好麻烦……反正你一个人也能搞定的吧？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Why're you giving me that look? You're the one who got it done, not me.
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了哦。……看着我干嘛，是你的任务完成了，又不是我的。

touch_body.captionEn: Aww, come ooon. I'm comfy right where I am – don't make me get up.
touch_body.caption: 欸——我还不想起来，再让我坐会~

touch_head.captionEn: I'm not sleepy. That was just a li'l yawn... *yaaawn*...
touch_head.caption: 我没困，只是打个哈欠而已…

touch_special.captionEn: When a human feels bliss, that's when their blood tastes sweetest♪
touch_special.caption: 据说，人感到最幸福的时刻，也是其血液最美味的时刻呢~

wedding.captionEn: Carefree as I am, we're stuck together now~ Stuck together by means of this ring, anyway. You're the only person I'll take orders from, and I expect you to do me a few favors in return~
wedding.caption: 这样一来，原本自由自在的我，就被“感情”所束缚了呢。谁叫我是自愿这么做的呢~能让我心甘情愿听话，可是独属于你一个人的特权哦。你也要付出相应的代价，在生活中的各个方面好好弥补我才行~

complete.captionEn: Wow, there's so much stuff! Did you bring all of that back yourselves? Amazing!
complete.caption: 噢噢，好多的物资啊！这些都是同伴们带回来的吗？好厉害！

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander! It was cold out on the seas, right? I've kept the water nice and hot for you, so warm up before you head out again!
home.caption: 指挥官，欢迎回来！海上很冷吧？玛莉事先弄好了热水的温度，请来泡澡暖下身子吧！

login.captionEn: Hum, humdeedum duuum♪ Heheh, come and relax in the onsen with me, Commander!
login.caption: 哼~哼哼~♪呵呵，指挥官也来泡温泉放松下吧♪

mail.captionEn: Commander, it looks like there's some new mail waiting for you!
mail.caption: 好像有新邮件来了呢，指挥官先生~

main_1.captionEn: Haha, everyone looks so comfy~♪ Thank you for bringing us to such a nice place♡
main_1.caption: 哼哼~大家都好舒服的样子♪谢谢你带我来这样的好地方♡

main_2.captionEn: I hear this hot water is great for your skin! Maybe it'll make me even more mature♪
main_2.caption: 听说这个温泉对皮肤很好！玛莉，说不定要比现在更成熟了♪

main_3.captionEn: Heheh, Commander? I know I'm adorable, but staring is bad manners, y'know.
main_3.caption: 呵呵，指挥官？就算玛莉很可爱，一直盯着看可不太礼貌哦？

mission.captionEn: Commander, there are still missions that haven't been completed! You didn't forget, did you?
mission.caption: 指挥官先生，还有没完成的任务哦！是忘记了吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Am I a big help, Commander?
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成！玛莉帮上指挥官的忙了吗？

touch_body.captionEn: Heheh, I'm getting all hot and lightheaded~♪
touch_body.caption: 呼呼，玛莉泡得有些晕了，身子都发热了♪

touch_head.captionEn: Geez, please don't treat me like a little kid!
touch_head.caption: 真是的，不要把玛莉当小孩子啦！

touch_special.captionEn: Geez! Quit messing around, Commander!
touch_special.caption: 真是的！可不能恶作剧呀，指挥官！

wedding.captionEn: Heheh~ I've received something special from you~ I feel the same as you, Commander. Heheh, all of our memories together are precious treasures to me!
wedding.caption: 呼呼♪从指挥官先生那里收到了特别的东西呢♥玛莉，也是一样的心情哦？嘻嘻，和指挥官先生一起的点滴回忆，玛莉都会当作宝物好好珍惜的~

complete.captionEn: The girls from the commission fleet have returned~ Akashi will check to see if they're injured, nya~!
complete.caption: 委托组的姐妹们回来了喵，明石去看看她们有没有受伤喵！

home.captionEn: If you are broken anywhere, Akashi can fix you up.
home.caption: 指挥官哪里坏了的话，明石可以帮你修……

login.captionEn: Commander~ good meowning~ *yawns*
login.caption: 指挥官好~……哈啊

mail.captionEn: *stares*... New mail has arrived~
mail.caption: 叽——新邮件已经送达了

main_1.captionEn: ...n...nya? Nnnh... zzzZZ...
main_1.caption: …ny…nya？嗯……zzzZZ

main_2.captionEn: Commander, what’s the matter? Can it be that you broke?
main_2.caption: 指挥官怎么了…难道是坏掉了？需要我修修喵？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, care for a beverage? Freshly squeezed from another ship nya~!
main_3.caption: 指挥官要来点饮料喵？我刚从别的船身上榨出来的喵

mission.captionEn: Commander, Commander~! You've got a new mission!
mission.caption: 指挥官指挥官，新的任务发布了哦

mission_complete.captionEn: Rewards are here~! Anything tasty... nya...?
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励到了，会有好吃的吗……

touch_body.captionEn: Akashi isn't malfunctioning, right?
touch_body.caption: 明石没有故障哦？

touch_head.captionEn: ...n...nya? Nnnh.... zzzZZ...
touch_head.caption: …ny…nya？嗯……zzzZZ

touch_special.captionEn: Nn? What's this feeling? It's as if I've been damaged.
touch_special.caption: 嗯……？这种感觉是？好像需要修理一下……

wedding.captionEn: What's this, Commander?  Does it need fixing? I don't really get it but, I'll keep it safe, nya~!
wedding.caption: 指挥官，这是什么，要明石来修理一下喵？——虽然不太明白，是很重要的东西的话明石就帮指挥官保管好了喵！

complete.captionEn: I hear footsteps. The commission team must be back... but I can't let you leave already♥
complete.caption: 脚、脚步声……？好像是委托组回来了……但我还不想指挥官离开呢♡……

home.captionEn: Commaaander! Welcome baaack! *sniiiff sniiiff*... God, you should really mark this place with your scent.
home.caption: 您回来了，指挥官……（嗅嗅）怎么办呢，好想让指挥官在这里每一处都留下气味……

login.captionEn: Commaaander, welcome baaack. My skin is all sticky and soft and cool... I think you'd really like touching it. Heheheh♥
login.caption: 指挥官……您终于回来了，我身上现在变得冰冰凉凉的……您摸起来的话，一定会觉得很舒服♡……

mail.captionEn: Go ahead and read your letter. In the meanwhile, I'm gonna have my way with you... Heheh...
mail.caption: 您可以查看邮件哦……不过我可能会趁机对您做点什么……嘿嘿♡……

main_1.captionEn: There's just us two in this quiet, cramped little place... Ahh, my heart is beating through my chest! Come closer and listen, Commander♥
main_1.caption: 这地方只有我和指挥官两个人……哈啊，我现在心跳得非常厉害哦……指挥官，来听听看吧……♡

main_2.captionEn: You look awfully hot, Commander. You're sweating even more than me... *sniff sniff*... God, smelling both our odors at the same time is next-level stuff♥
main_2.caption: 指挥官的脸很红哦……看起来现在反而是您容易出汗了……（嗅嗅）整个房间里都是我和指挥官的气味♡……哈……太美妙了♡……

main_3.captionEn: I wasn't lying when I said I wanted to swim with you, I just had a change of heart. This is a rare situation and I need to jump on it. Heheh...
main_3.caption: 想和您一起游泳不是借口哦……只是我中途就改变主意了，毕竟这样的机会很难得嘛，嘿嘿♡……

main_4.captionEn: All this moving around has made my bikini strings mighty tight... Come loosen them up for me, Commander♥
main_4.caption: 因为刚刚一直在动来动去，系带有点勒进去了……指挥官，快点用您的手帮帮我吧♡……

mission.captionEn: Commandeeer... Do you have any "missions" I can do here and now?
mission.caption: 指挥官，要不要在这里，让我也执行些什么任务呢♡……？

mission_complete.captionEn: Wooow, completing missions despite your current situation. Impressive, Commander♥
mission_complete.caption: 这种状态下也能出色地完成任务，真不愧是指挥官呢♡……

touch_body.captionEn: Commandeeer! Between this and my usual clothes, which do you like touching more?
touch_body.caption: 指挥官♡……穿成这样的我和之前的我……哪个触感更棒呢？……

touch_head.captionEn: C-Commander... Talk about sudden... Ahah♥
touch_head.caption: 指、指挥官♡……突然就……哈啊♡……

touch_special.captionEn: Hahh... Ahh... Yes, this is exactly what I locked the door for!
touch_special.caption: 哈……啊……把门紧锁就是为了这一刻哦♡……

wedding.captionEn: On my name as an Orthodoxy judge, I swear my fidelity to you. Henceforth, I will be your axe... Heheh. I will follow your every order and take your every punishment, without any objection or complaint... ♥
wedding.caption: 作为教廷审判官，我在此为您立下忠诚的誓言，我将作为您手中的利刃，从今往后……心甘情愿服从您的一切命令，承受您的一切怒火……任您驱使……绝无怨言……

complete.captionEn: Please form the next commission team, okay?
complete.caption: 该派出下一批委托队伍了呢

home.captionEn: Where were you all this time? Don't tell me... you got lost?
home.caption: 啊，指挥官，你刚刚去哪里了？该不会…是迷路了吧？

login.captionEn: It'll be a bit of a walk, but won't you come along with me?
login.caption: 指挥官，稍微陪我走一段路吧。

mail.captionEn: Mail? I'll check to make sure there's nothing suspicious inside.
mail.caption: 信件？我确认一下，没有什么奇怪的内容吧？

main_1.captionEn: I only found this place by pure chance. Thinking back on it, I wonder how I was feeling when I stumbled upon this back alleyway instead of following the main road...
main_1.caption: 这个地方是之前来参拜的时候偶然发现的。回想起来，当时不走大路反而走进这种小路的我究竟是怎样一种心情呢…

main_2.captionEn: Please, watch your step. The road is very narrow.
main_2.caption: 路有点窄，请注意脚下

main_3.captionEn: If we're talking about dressing up properly for the festival, this is definitely the getup. However, I struggled a bit while changing into this. I even got laughed at by Agano. ...*sigh*
main_3.caption: 祭典自然是要换上与之相符的衣裳，不过穿起来确实很麻烦。还因此被阿贺野笑了好久…唉

mission.captionEn: If you feel overwhelmed by the number of missions, why not try sorting them based on priority?
mission.caption: 任务很多的话，不如先按照重要程度规划一下吧

mission_complete.captionEn: I've received the mission rewards. Please double check that nothing has been left out.
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励拿到了哦。保险起见，确认一下有没有缺少吧

touch_body.captionEn: Hm... Ah, I'll be fine even if you don't prop me up like that. ...Um, thank you very much.
touch_body.caption: 唔，这里不用扶着我也没问题的…总之，谢谢了。

touch_special.captionEn: Apologize and reflect upon your actions. Don't think that you're going to get away with it just because we're at a festival!
touch_special.caption: 就算是节日，也是免不了反省和检讨的！

wedding.captionEn: In order to not just accept your feelings, but to reciprocate them as well... Umm, let's see... I'll need to prepare meals, go on dates on days off, but I also need to make sure I don't lose motivation for my regular duties, like practice... Eh? Ah, sorry, I got lost in my train of thought. Huh? I-I should keep going?
wedding.caption: 既然接受了指挥官的心意，那我也要有所回应才行。之后的话……约会、做便当、培养感情，但是训练不能落下，秘书舰的工作也……啊，对不起，我只是发了会呆。我，我们继续吧？

complete.captionEn: I've received word that the commission team has returned. Why don't you take a quick break from work and go welcome them back?
complete.caption: 是委托队的伙伴们的回港联络。这点小事也算不上工作，要不先休息一下去迎接她们？

home.captionEn: Welcome back. Care for refreshments? Heehee, make sure to finish the soda before it goes flat.
home.caption: 辛苦了。要不要来点冷饮？里面还有不少气泡，喝的时候要注意一点哦。

login.captionEn: You should enjoy yourself at the beach, just like you ordered me to. Hehe.
login.caption: 好好享受海水吧，就像你要求我的那样，呵呵~

mail.captionEn: Mail? I'll check to make sure there's nothing suspicious inside.
mail.caption: 信件？我确认一下，没有什么奇怪的内容吧？

main_1.captionEn: If you're stuck trying to think about what fun things to do next, why don't you ask the others? I'm sure they'd love to join you for anything you'd like.
main_1.caption: 若是不知道接下来要玩什么，不妨问问大家的意见？我也和你一起。

main_2.captionEn: Sakawa... I have an inkling of where she might be. Wouldn't surprise me if she's at a beachside hut somewhere, stuffing her face with sweets. Sigh...
main_2.caption: 酒匂她…我大概知道她在哪了。反正应该就在海边小屋里面享受着甜食吧。

main_3.captionEn: I picked this swimsuit because you told me we were going to play on the beach, but instead... No, never mind. But did you perhaps... want to see me in something more risqué?
main_3.caption: 为了放松玩耍所以选了这件泳装，或许…啊，没什么。还是说，你其实想看…更刺激一些的吗？

mission.captionEn: If you feel overwhelmed by the number of missions, why not try sorting them based on priority?
mission.caption: 任务很多的话，不如先按照重要程度规划一下吧

mission_complete.captionEn: I've received the mission rewards. Please double check that nothing has been left out.
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励拿到了哦。保险起见，确认一下有没有缺少吧

touch_body.captionEn: Want another go?
touch_body.caption: 要再来一次吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Wh-where are you touching... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: 这、这里是……///

wedding.captionEn: In order to not just accept your feelings, but to reciprocate them as well... Umm, let's see... I'll need to prepare meals, go on dates on days off, but I also need to make sure I don't lose motivation for my regular duties, like practice... Eh? Ah, sorry, I got lost in my train of thought. Huh? I-I should keep going?
wedding.caption: 既然接受了指挥官的心意，那我也要有所回应才行。之后的话……约会、做便当、培养感情，但是训练不能落下，秘书舰的工作也……啊，对不起，我只是发了会呆。我，我们继续吧？

complete.captionEn: The commission's done? Okay then, take five. Commander, you should probably go out and meet them.
complete.caption: 委托完成了？那中场休息5分钟，指挥官，你先去接她们吧

home.captionEn: Nice work out there, got a request you want me to sing?
home.caption: 辛苦了，就给你唱首歌吧

login.captionEn: Thank you very m–! It's you, Commander.
login.caption: 请多多支持——啊，是指挥官啊

mail.captionEn: There's so many fan letters...! Being an idol is so exhausting...
mail.caption: 今天又收到了好多信件……做偶像也真是不容易

main_1.captionEn: C- Commander... "Jia you! ☆" Was that cute enough...? Don't look at me like that! This is serious business right here!
main_1.caption: 指挥官，你看——加油~这个姿势够不够可爱和吸引人？……干什么那副表情，这是工作，我可不会敷衍

main_2.captionEn: After studying all that kung fu, Idol dancing is a piece of cake for me and Ping Hai! Hah hah!
main_2.caption: 因为学过功夫，偶像的舞蹈功课对我和平海来说简直小菜一碟呢，哼哼！

main_3.captionEn: Oh, right! Commander, next time me and Ping Hai put out a single, we'll definitely save you one.
main_3.caption: 啊，对了，指挥官，我和平海哪天真的出专辑了的话就送你一张吧

mission.captionEn: A new offer...? Heh, hehehehe... Sure, I'll keep packing in as much work as my schedule can take!
mission.caption: 又有新的演出？没问题，在日程表排满前，多少工作我都会做的

mission_complete.captionEn: The fans make me really happy, sure, but next time I'll have to teach them how to save money!
mission_complete.caption: 虽然粉丝们的心意我很高兴，但是，下次我要好好教她们勤俭节约的道理！

touch_body.captionEn: Don't worry, I'm wearing shorts underneath. And anyway if somebody tried something gross, I've got a roundhouse kick with their name on it!
touch_body.caption: 放心吧，下面好好穿着底裤呢——而且，要是遇到图谋不轨的人，我就赏那家伙一记回旋踢

touch_special.captionEn: Roundhouse kick!
touch_special.caption: 吃我回旋踢！

wedding.captionEn: ... Since you trust me so much, Commander, why don't we plan ahead? The next focus of our fleet is... cost cutting! We've got to maintain the fleet by minimizing expenses, and... Hey! Don't run away!
wedding.caption: ……既然指挥官你这么信任我，那我们就开始规划一下吧，接下来舰队的方针就是——开源节流！尽可能的节省才能让舰队运营下去，还有……别跑！

complete.captionEn: Commissions completed. Hehe, don't you want to go check up on them together?
complete.caption: 委托完成了。呵呵，一起去看看吧？

home.captionEn: Make sure you clean every last bit. ...Hehe, I'm talking about the machine, of course.
home.caption: 来好好地把每~一寸地方都洗干净吧。…呵呵，我说的可是这些机械哦？

login.captionEn: Commander, you're working pretty hard. Hehehe, take care not to wear yourself out~♪
login.caption: 指挥官挺努力的嘛。呵呵，小心别累坏了就好♪

mail.captionEn: There's new mail. Hehe~
mail.caption: 有新邮件呢~呵呵呵

main_1.captionEn: Here, let's pop a bottle to practice uncorking the celebratory champagne~ What's wrong, Commander? Are you not going to drink?
main_1.caption: 先来干一杯作为到时候庆祝喝香槟的练习吧~指挥官~怎么，不能喝吗~？

main_2.captionEn: Heinrich wants to compete in the race? How very like her... Wait a second, does she even know how to drive?
main_2.caption: 听说海因里希也想参加比赛？确实像是她会喜欢的……等等，她会开车吗？

main_3.captionEn: Why don't you try getting changed into something too, Hipper? You know the Commander's secretly looking forward to it, right? ...If you want, I'll even lend you the outfit I'm wearing.
main_3.caption: 姐姐你要不要也换一身衣服？指挥官其实很期待的哦…需要的话，我这一身借给你也行哦？

mission.captionEn: Missions... aren't there any interesting ones?
mission.caption: 任务……会有什么新奇的内容吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the rewards. My portion? Not interested~
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，有奖励哦——我？没有兴趣

touch_body.captionEn: Have you finished having your fun?
touch_body.caption: 这点程度就满足了吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Just like that~♡
touch_special.caption: 就是这样子的哦♡

wedding.captionEn: So this is the answer you're giving me? What shall I do? What a dense commander. I have long stopped being the empty person I was before. Did you forget that you were the one who changed me?
wedding.caption: ——这就是你给我的答案吗？怎么办好呢……噗，真是笨啊，我的指挥官大人，我早就不是一开始那个对什么都感到空虚的我了，你难道忘了是谁让我改变的吗？

complete.captionEn: Commission completed? Let's see if there is anything interesting to report.
complete.caption: 委托完成了吗，呵呵，那我们就去看看有没有什么有趣的东西吧

home.captionEn: Let's celebrate the wonderful outing we had together, Commander~ It'd be such a waste to not drink one more glass... hmm? Is something wrong? Cat got your tongue?
home.caption: 为庆祝指挥官陪伴的这美好一刻~不再来一杯就太可惜了…嗯？怎么了？有什么在意的吗？

login.captionEn: "Welcome back. What'll be your order?" Is that what you were expecting? Heehee.
login.caption: “欢迎光临，想要喝点什么？”…这时候是不是该这么说才应景呢？呵呵呵~

mail.captionEn: There's new mail. Hehe~
mail.caption: 有新邮件呢~呵呵呵

main_1.captionEn: Hehe. What are you all nervous for? Why don't you sit down at the counter? Here's the wine I recommend.
main_1.caption: 呵呵，别这么紧张，在吧台坐下吧，我给你介绍下我推荐的红酒。

main_2.captionEn: You know, when we ran into Hipper the other day on our day out, she started sulking and turned beet-red the moment she saw your face. I wonder why? Heehee.
main_2.caption: 说起来，之前一起出门遇到希佩尔时，姐姐一看到指挥官就脸红闹别扭了。不知是怎么了呢？呵呵呵~

main_3.captionEn: It's customary to pour wine into a wine glass, but I'd like to try a different container. I wonder how I'd make a cocktail out of it.
main_3.caption: 喝红酒时一般是用玻璃杯，不过将来想也试试用别的容器品尝。酒要怎么调配才好呢？

mission.captionEn: Missions... aren't there any interesting ones?
mission.caption: 任务……会有什么新奇的内容吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Though I doubt the rewards can beat this moment, shouldn't you go pick them up anyway?
mission_complete.caption: 虽然不觉得有什么奖励能胜过此刻，不过还是去领取一下吧？

touch_body.captionEn: Have you finished having your fun?
touch_body.caption: 这点程度就满足了吗？

touch_special.captionEn: Hehehe, don't be in such a hurry. The night has only just begun♡
touch_special.caption: 呵呵呵，别着急。夜晚才刚刚开始呢♡
